The Experts Behind Every Journey

Our Experts

Founder & CEO

Supriya Kumar Chakraborty

Twenty-five years in education, career and image consultancy, and Chief Executive of SA Associates and SA Elite Tours. Awarded a Quality in Business certificate by the International Trade Council.

Began his career as Chief Education Officer at the Russian Embassy, where he served for twelve years and was named Best Employee in 2001. He has spoken at the Canada India Education Council Business Summit, an annual conference in Boston, and ICEF’s Education Network for Agents in Berlin.

Education, Training & Credentials
  • Leaders of Learning — HarvardX, Harvard University
  • Leadership & Change Management — University of Dhaka
  • Canada Course Graduate — DFATD
  • Qualified Education Agent Counsellor — PIER, Australia
  • Canada Specialist — Canadian Tourism Commission
  • Berlin Specialist — Travel & Trade Department, Germany
  • Member: AICI Toronto · ACTE USA · NCDA USA · Lions Club 315 B-2
Chief Consultant

Bapan Saha

An international education counsellor based at the Dhaka corporate office, and the first Bangladeshi education consultant to pass the Canada Specialist Program examination conducted by the Canadian Tourism Commission.

He has completed specialised training in migration law at the Sir Zelman Cowen Centre, Victoria University, Melbourne, and travels regularly to Australia, Canada, the USA, Germany, Switzerland, France, the UK, Japan, South Korea, Singapore and China to keep up with changes in the sector.

Education, Training & Credentials
  • Canada Specialist Accreditation — Canadian Tourism Commission
  • Canada Course Graduate
  • Qualified Education Agent Counsellor (QEAC)
  • ICEF Trained Agent Counsellor
  • Education New Zealand Trained Agent
  • Certified Austrian Travel Specialist
  • Migration Law — Sir Zelman Cowen Centre, Victoria University
Regional Manager · Chittagong

Monojit Das

Heads the Chittagong branch and holds an MBA in Marketing and Management from Mid Sweden University. He is the only ICEF trained agent consultant in the Chittagong division.

His professional travel for study visits, workshops and education fairs covers the USA, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Dubai, Germany and Malaysia — experience he brings directly to student and immigration files.

Education, Training & Credentials
  • MBA, Marketing & Management — Mid Sweden University
  • ICEF Trained Agent Counsellor
  • Canada Specialist — Canadian Tourism Commission
  • New York Specialist · Global Explorer Specialist · Iceland Specialist
Regional Manager · Kolkata

Finn Goswami

Leads SA Associates in Kolkata with an MBA from Jaipur National University and a B.Tech from MAKAUT, formerly the West Bengal University of Technology — a background combining business and engineering.

He guides students through visa and admission processes as an online consultant, and manages the company’s website, blog and social channels. His travel for education workshops and fairs includes Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, Dubai, Bhutan and Thailand.

Education, Training & Credentials
  • MBA — Jaipur National University
  • B.Tech — MAKAUT (West Bengal University of Technology)
  • Canada Specialist Program

Premium Consultant

Ruslan Shah Adib

Based at the Dhaka corporate office with a bachelor’s and master’s in Human Resource Management from Independent University, Bangladesh.

He specialises in visa applications — preparing the file, briefing the student and tracking changes in requirements. His education workshop and fair travel covers Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Dubai, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia and Thailand.
